title: 12 Best Currywurst in Berlin (2026)
description: The best currywurst in Berlin, Germany — curated from Reddit reviews and local food blogs. From Curry 36 to Konnopke's Imbiss, find the legendary imbiss stands that locals swear by.

places.name: Curry 36

redditQuotes.text: 15 years ago I had the Curry 36 Currywurst and it was the best I ever had.
Curry 36 is the most important and iconic currywurst stand in Berlin. Mehringdamm in Kreuzberg is crowded day and night.

places.verdict: Calling Curry 36 a Berlin institution would be an understatement. The Kreuzberg location on Mehringdamm is especially treasured — there's always a queue, but it's worth persevering. The herbaceous, savory sausage with mild curry notes shining through zesty tomato sauce is the currywurst against which all others are measured.

comparison.best for: The quintessential Berlin currywurst experience — day or night
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 13,495 reviews · Open until 5 AM · Classic + vegan + organic options
comparison.limitations: Always a queue; heavily touristy; some locals say it's overhyped
comparison.what to order: Classic currywurst mit Darm (with skin) + Pommes mit Mayo. Sauces range from classic to extra spicy — start with classic.

places.whatToOrder: Classic currywurst mit Darm (with skin) + Pommes mit Mayo. Sauces range from classic to extra spicy — start with classic.

places.name: Konnopke's Imbiss

redditQuotes.text: Konnopke's Imbiss has a long history of serving delicious Currywurst. This is my favourite on the list!

places.verdict: A must for currywurst fans since 1930 — directly under the elevated U-Bahn line at Eberswalder Straße. The East Berlin counterpart to Curry 36, Konnopke's is known for its special blend of spices and crispy skinless sausages. It's always a topic of debate among Berliners — for some, it's the only true currywurst; for others, it's long outdated.

comparison.best for: Berlin history buffs and the photogenic U-Bahn setting
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · Nearly 100 years old · Iconic U-Bahn location · Cult status
comparison.limitations: Closed Mon & Sun; limited hours (11 AM–6 PM); can be tourist-heavy
comparison.what to order: Currywurst ohne Darm (skinless, East Berlin style) with Pommes Schranke (fries with ketchup & mayo). Ask for their hottest sauce if you dare.

places.whatToOrder: Currywurst ohne Darm (skinless, East Berlin style) with Pommes Schranke (fries with ketchup & mayo). Ask for their hottest sauce if you dare.

places.name: Curry 61

redditQuotes.text: The salty sausage balanced out the fiery sauce that was packed full of juicy tomatoes and umami Worcestershire sauce.

places.verdict: This family business has two branches in Mitte and relies on freshly cooked sauces several times a day, the best frying oil, and meat straight from a Berlin butcher. With 8,000+ reviews and a 4.7 rating, it's the highest-rated traditional currywurst stand in central Berlin. Their vegan currywurst is particularly well-reviewed — the fiery sauce balances perfectly against the plant-based sausage.

comparison.best for: Highest-rated central currywurst with excellent vegan options
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ · 8,086 reviews · Freshly made sauces daily · Near Hackescher Markt
comparison.limitations: Long queues at lunch; central Mitte location means tourist traffic
comparison.what to order: Classic currywurst with their fresh-daily sauce. The vegan version is excellent too. Pair with hand-cut fries.

places.whatToOrder: Classic currywurst with their fresh-daily sauce. The vegan version is excellent too. Pair with hand-cut fries.

places.name: Curry Baude

redditQuotes.text: Curry Baude is a hidden gem known for its traditional approach to currywurst — probably the most popular currywurst among Berliners themselves.
The sauce had such an addictive, tangy taste, and the peppery paprika added a gentle sweetness.

places.verdict: A low-key corner kiosk in the listed entrance of the Gesundbrunnen U-Bahn station, Curry Baude is probably the most popular currywurst among Berliners themselves. Run by Reina Lehmann since the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989, the homemade sauce is both fruity and spicy, the portions are generous, and the old-school red-and-white facade radiates pure Berlin charm.

comparison.best for: Authentic neighborhood currywurst away from the tourist trail
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · Opens at 6 AM · Homemade fruity-spicy sauce · Generous portions · Zero tourists
comparison.limitations: Wedding neighborhood is off the beaten path; limited seating
comparison.what to order: Currywurst mit Darm with extra sauce — their tangy, peppery paprika sauce clings to the meaty chunks perfectly. Add fries with mayo (Pommes mit Mayo).

places.whatToOrder: Currywurst mit Darm with extra sauce — their tangy, peppery paprika sauce clings to the meaty chunks perfectly. Add fries with mayo (Pommes mit Mayo).

places.name: Ketch'up 35

redditQuotes.text: Even the Currywurst Museum has commended Neukölln's Ketch'up 35. The quality of the sausage was evident from the first mouthful.

places.verdict: Even the now-closed Currywurst Museum commended Ketch'up 35 — and with a 4.8 rating from nearly 2,800 reviews, this Neukölln snack bar lives up to every word. The quality of the sausage is evident from the first mouthful, and the juices seep into the zingy, lightly spiced sauce, intensifying the flavor. This is the Berlin currywurst cognoscenti's top pick.

comparison.best for: The highest-rated currywurst experience in all of Berlin
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ (highest on list) · Museum-endorsed · Open until 11 PM · Long hours daily
comparison.limitations: Neukölln location is south of the tourist center; basic stand setup
comparison.what to order: Their signature currywurst — the sauce is what makes it special. Pair with fries and don't skip the extra curry powder on top.

places.whatToOrder: Their signature currywurst — the sauce is what makes it special. Pair with fries and don't skip the extra curry powder on top.

places.name: Zur Bratpfanne

redditQuotes.text: Zur Bratpfanne in Steglitz is Currywurst how it was meant to be done: quickly, stood up, and outside.

places.verdict: Currywurst how it was meant to be done: quickly, stood up, and outside. Zur Bratpfanne near the Botanical Gardens is a bustling fast food stand that has been serving Berliners for generations. The skin-on sausage brings crunch to every bite, and the sauce is rich, fragrant, and silky.

comparison.best for: Late-night currywurst in a true neighborhood setting
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · Open until 1 AM Mon–Sat · Near Botanical Gardens · Generations of loyal regulars
comparison.limitations: Steglitz is far from central tourist areas; Sunday hours limited (1–9 PM)
comparison.what to order: Currywurst mit Darm (skin-on) for the satisfying crunch. The sauce is particularly memorable — rich and fragrant with a silky consistency.

places.whatToOrder: Currywurst mit Darm (skin-on) for the satisfying crunch. The sauce is particularly memorable — rich and fragrant with a silky consistency.

places.name: Curry & Chili

redditQuotes.text: Curry & Chili is known for its selection of spicy Currywurst sauces, catering to those who love a bit of heat.

places.verdict: This currywurst is not for the faint-hearted. What at first seems like an unspectacular snack bar in Wedding turns out to be a fiery undertaking — you can choose between 12 different levels of spiciness. One of the sauces is called "shortly before death." They also offer standard, vegan, and vegetarian options for those who value their taste buds.

comparison.best for: Spice lovers and the "how hot can you go?" challenge
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · 12 spice levels · Vegan options · Unique experience
comparison.limitations: Off the tourist trail in Wedding; limited Sunday hours
comparison.what to order: Start with level 3–4 unless you have an iron stomach. The "shortly before death" sauce is genuinely dangerous. Vegan option available at all spice levels.

places.whatToOrder: Start with level 3–4 unless you have an iron stomach. The "shortly before death" sauce is genuinely dangerous. Vegan option available at all spice levels.

places.name: Curry Wolf

redditQuotes.text: Curry Wolf is famous for its addictive 'Opium' sauce, offering a memorable Currywurst experience.

places.verdict: With a view of the Brandenburg Gate, Curry Wolf is a Berlin classic. Their claim to fame is the homemade "Opium" sauce — a proprietary recipe that's described as "ferociously addictive." Four other locations across the city (Ku'Damm, Lichtenrade, Steglitz, and Potsdam) speak to their popularity.

comparison.best for: Currywurst with a view of the Brandenburg Gate
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · Signature Opium sauce · Prime location · Multiple branches
comparison.limitations: Tourist-heavy location; smaller menu than some competitors
comparison.what to order: Currywurst with the Opium sauce — it's what they're famous for. The homemade ketchup is excellent too.

places.whatToOrder: Currywurst with the Opium sauce — it's what they're famous for. The homemade ketchup is excellent too.

places.name: Krasselt's Imbiss

redditQuotes.text: Known for its exceptional ketchup, Krasselt's Imbiss in Steglitz offers a quieter, local favorite spot for Currywurst lovers.

places.verdict: A nostalgic neighborhood imbiss in Steglitz that's been impressing regulars for decades with its traditional recipe and friendly service. The spicy sauce is the star here — it makes every sausage an experience. If you're in the southwest of Berlin, Krasselt's is worth the detour.

comparison.best for: Nostalgic neighborhood currywurst with decades of tradition
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Decades of history · Friendly service · Great spicy sauce
comparison.limitations: Far from central Berlin; basic stand setup
comparison.what to order: Currywurst with their spicy house sauce — it's what keeps the regulars coming back. Ask for extra sauce.

places.whatToOrder: Currywurst with their spicy house sauce — it's what keeps the regulars coming back. Ask for extra sauce.

places.name: Bier's Kudamm 195

redditQuotes.text: Bier's Kudamm 195 has been serving up Currywurst to generations of Berliners since 1965. You can take them up on an offer of Currywurst & champagne.

places.verdict: Traditional street food in a fancy corner of Berlin. Surrounded by luxury stores on the Ku'Damm, Bier's has been serving currywurst since 1965. They even offer currywurst with champagne — a combination that has to be tasted (once) to be believed. Open until 4 AM on weekends for the late-night Ku'Damm crowd.

comparison.best for: Upscale currywurst experience on Berlin's luxury boulevard
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Since 1965 · Open until 4 AM Fri–Sat · Currywurst + champagne
comparison.limitations: Pricier than other stands; touristy Ku'Damm location
comparison.what to order: Classic currywurst — and if you're feeling fancy, pair it with a glass of Sekt (sparkling wine). The contrast is genuinely fun.

places.whatToOrder: Classic currywurst — and if you're feeling fancy, pair it with a glass of Sekt (sparkling wine). The contrast is genuinely fun.

places.name: Witty's Organic Food
places.verdict: Organic currywurst for everyone! The sausage comes from species-appropriate farming and the side dishes are completely certified organic. Located directly on Wittenbergplatz opposite the legendary KaDeWe department store, Witty's proves that sustainable eating doesn't mean compromising on taste. Also at Friedrichstraße and BER airport.

comparison.best for: Conscious eaters who want organic currywurst without compromising taste
comparison.strengths: 100% certified organic · Opposite KaDeWe · 3 locations incl. BER airport
comparison.limitations: 4.0★ lower than competitors; pricier for the organic premium
comparison.what to order: Organic Bio-Currywurst with their house-made organic ketchup. The fries are also organic.

places.whatToOrder: Organic Bio-Currywurst with their house-made organic ketchup. The fries are also organic.

places.name: Vöner

redditQuotes.text: The vegan version impresses with a spicy note and is often praised as the best alternative to the classic sausage.

places.verdict: Perfect for anyone who loves the taste but wants to avoid meat. Vöner's vegan currywurst is often praised as the best plant-based alternative to the classic sausage. They also offer other Berlin classics in plant-based versions, but the currywurst with its spicy note is the star. In the heart of Friedrichshain's food scene.

comparison.best for: The best fully vegan currywurst experience in Berlin
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · 2,174 reviews · 100% vegan menu · Friedrichshain nightlife area
comparison.limitations: Not for purists seeking traditional pork sausage; opens at noon
comparison.what to order: Vegan currywurst with fries. Their spicy sauce version is the standout — the heat masks any "fake meat" taste.
